questions.question: How can you avoid becoming an aggressive driver?

options.text: Talk on your cell phone while driving.

questions.explanation: Plan ahead and allow extra time for traffic delays. This helps you avoid frustration, which can lead to aggressive driving. Other helpful strategies include driving at a safe speed, keeping a safe distance behind other vehicles, avoiding rude gestures, and keeping both hands on the wheel.

questions.question: What is reaction distance?

options.text: The distance you travel from when you decide to brake until you actually press the brake pedal
The distance you travel from when a hazard appears until you see it
The distance you travel from when you see a hazard until you decide to brake

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance you travel from when you decide to brake until you actually press the brake pedal
questions.explanation: Total stopping distance has three parts: perception distance, reaction distance, and braking distance. Reaction distance is how far your vehicle travels between the moment you decide to brake and the moment your foot actually presses the brake pedal.

questions.question: Converter dollies made after 1998 on doubles and triples:

options.text: Do not always have anti-lock brakes.

questions.explanation: All converter dollies built on or after March 1, 1998 must have anti-lock brakes.

questions.question: Using a hand-held mobile device while driving is:

options.text: Okay if the weather is clear.
Allowed if it is for work.

questions.explanation: Using a hand-held cell phone while driving a commercial vehicle is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: When stopping, how should you apply the brake pedal?
questions.explanation: Push the brake pedal down slowly when stopping. Gradual braking helps you maintain control of your vehicle.

questions.question: If a train is approaching a railroad crossing, you should:

options.text: Try to cross the tracks quickly.
Stop and wait for the train to pass before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and wait for the train to pass before crossing.
questions.explanation: Never try to beat a train across the tracks. It is hard to judge how fast a train is moving. If you see a train approaching, stop and wait for it to pass completely before you cross.

questions.question: When coupling vehicles, you should:

options.text: Assume all vehicles are the same.
Make sure you are coupling correctly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure you are coupling correctly.
questions.explanation: Incorrect coupling and uncoupling can be very dangerous.

questions.question: If you need to turn to avoid a hazard, you should:

options.text: Not brake because it may lock the wheels.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not brake because it may lock the wheels.
questions.explanation: Do not brake while turning sharply to avoid a hazard. Braking while turning can lock your wheels and cause your vehicle to skid out of control.

questions.question: Within 10 minutes of stopping on the side of the road, you must:
questions.explanation: When you stop on the side of the road, you must place emergency warning devices within 10 minutes.

questions.question: Having anti-lock brakes on just one axle:

options.text: Will give you better control when braking.
Will likely break your air brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Will give you better control when braking.
questions.explanation: Anti-lock brakes on just one axle will still give you more control during braking than having no anti-lock brakes at all.

questions.question: ____ is a thin, clear layer of ice on the road surface.
questions.explanation: Black ice is thin, clear ice that lets you see the road through it. A road with black ice looks wet, not icy. Watch for black ice when the road looks wet and temperatures are near freezing.

questions.question: When operating a set of doubles, the shut-off valves at the rear of the first trailer should be:
questions.explanation: When operating doubles or triples, close the shut-off valves at the rear of the last trailer. Keep all other shut-off valves open.

questions.question: In heavy traffic, the safest driving speed is:
questions.explanation: In heavy traffic, drive at the same speed as other vehicles. When two vehicles travel in the same direction at the same speed, they cannot hit each other.

questions.question: An exhaust system should be:
questions.explanation: Check that exhaust system parts are not loose, broken, or missing. All parts must be properly mounted and not rubbing against other vehicle parts.

questions.question: Skids happen when:

options.text: Tires lose grip on the road.
There is too much weight in the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tires lose grip on the road.
questions.explanation: Skids happen when tires lose traction with the road. This can happen from over-braking, over-accelerating, over-steering, or driving too fast.

questions.question: Steering wheel play of more than ____ can make steering difficult.
questions.explanation: A steering wheel should have no more than 10 degrees of play. This equals about 2 inches of movement at the rim of a 20-inch wheel. More play makes steering difficult.

questions.question: On a curve, the posted speed limit:

options.text: Can still cause a vehicle to tip over.
Is the minimum legal speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can still cause a vehicle to tip over.
questions.explanation: The posted speed limit on a curve may be safe for cars but too fast for larger vehicles like trucks. A truck driven at the posted limit on a curve can tip over.

questions.question: After changing a tire, the driver should stop after driving a short distance to:

options.text: Recheck the tightness of the lug nuts.
Check if rocks are in the tread.

questions.correctAnswerText: Recheck the tightness of the lug nuts.
questions.explanation: After a tire change, drive a short distance and then stop to recheck that the lug nuts are tight.

questions.question: In an engine fire, you should not:

options.text: Turn off the engine right away.

questions.explanation: In an engine fire, turn off the engine immediately. Do not open the hood if you can avoid it.

questions.question: During a static leakage test, what is the maximum safe leakage rate for a double combination vehicle?
questions.explanation: In a static leakage test on a double combination vehicle with air brakes, leakage should not exceed 3 psi in one minute. Higher leakage means something needs repair and the vehicle should not be driven.
